provenance.execution_policy: Sequential benchmarks, no competing builds/benchmarks; no GPU kernels dispatched; only ignored API probe built between timing suites.

baseline.wall_time_limit: Python subprocess timeout wait polls up to 50ms on Linux; stored at 1ms resolution. Primary times are successful process elapsed observations, unsuitable for small mode differences. Warmup warms OS caches, not session state.

supplement.wall_time: perf_counter around subprocess.run with PIPE/communicate timeout; separate dataset because flags/output capture differ; prefer for small timing comparisons but only three samples
supplement.assembly_scope: Separate ptxas process elapsed; fixed final supplemental PTX, no Slang compile included.

api_session.scope: Two persistent processes, one per fresh/shared global-session policy. Fresh compile request each iteration, CLI mode and enableGLSL=true. No material-module cache introduced. Same PTX bytes as baseline. Destructor and lifecycle times use steady_clock; API phase counters truncate to whole ms. Global creation within a warmed process differs from fresh-process startup.
api_session.discarded_probe: Initial default-GLSL API runs retained locally as initial-default-glsl-session-*; excluded because setup differed from CLI.

interpretation.main_measured_work: Shared frontend semantic checking ~650ms; builtin load ~205–211ms in fresh CLI processes; shared link/optimization ~321–343ms. These are inclusive scopes, not additive exclusive samples.

one_candidate.name: Amortize global-session lifetime across a bounded serial compilation batch
one_candidate.layer: Host harness/session ownership, not NVVM IR semantics, provider, or downstream optimizer
one_candidate.evidence: Ignored API probe reduces warmed in-process request lifecycle median by 11.898%, with byte-identical eval_buffer NVVM O3 PTX and explicit fresh requests. This is a feasibility signal, not measured corpus-runner speedup.
one_candidate.next_gate: Before production change, repeat equivalent API experiment over all six cells with request-order permutations and bounded-batch memory/lifetime checks; retain fresh-process results. Do not broaden compiler pipeline design from these measurements.
one_candidate.acceptance_metric: On identical optimized binaries and fixed material flags, two warmup batches and at least seven measured serial six-cell batches: >=10% reduction in median total batch lifecycle wall time: fresh global per request versus one global per six-cell batch, including global creation and destruction at every bounded batch boundary, no >5% per-cell compile-call median regression, identical PTX and successful assembly for all six identities. Preserve per-cell timeouts/crash isolation/output oracles and a fresh-session lane; require full frozen/discovery checkpoint before adopting any runner change.
one_candidate.status: Candidate only; no implementation in this slice.

timer_cautions: SemanticChecking equals checkAllTranslationUnits; both included in frontEndExecute.
generateIRForTranslationUnit is included in generateIR, which is included in frontEndExecute.
compileInner/endToEndActions encompass frontend and output; generateOutput includes linking, code generation and downstream work.

Baseline specializeModule and simplifyIR are inclusive shared-pass totals. Detailed wrapper timers reuse their names and add overlapping durations: two specializeModule counts and ten simplifyIR counts do not indicate doubled work.
-report-downstream-time clears profiler at compile entry, so supplemental logs intentionally omit global builtin creation.
Whole-process minus nested phase timers cannot be interpreted as backend exclusive time.
interpretation.perf: perf stat -e task-clock -- true denied at perf_event_paranoid=4; no settings/packages changed.

inherited_runtime_preservation.ledger_policy: All first-known history, reproduction, evidence, diagnostics and resolved records remain in unchanged accepted 210 manifest; no classifications or denominators reset.

limitations: No material runtime bindings, textures/LUT inputs, output oracle, GPU runtime, GPU speed or register-count performance claims.
Seven baseline process observations have timeout-wait quantization; precise supplementary attribution has only three measured samples per cell.
API experiment is one entry/mode and separate lifecycle setup, not a measured improvement in existing corpus runners.
OS file and allocator/library warmth affect repeat measurements; no CPU pinning, frequency lock or thermal model.

parent_acceptance.independent_review: Recomputed six-cell primary 54-attempt counts/medians/spreads; all six assemblies pass. Recomputed fresh/shared API medians and 11.8977% reduction, verified all18 API PTX hashes against baseline. All18 structured references and12 artifact hashes match. Reviewed probe scope and inclusive timing limits.
parent_acceptance.next_gate: Six-cell bounded-batch global-session experiment, including creation/destruction and order/memory evidence, before production adoption.
